mistake_reason: At step 6, the Assistant asserted specific follower counts and cited non-existent sources (a fabricated DeepLearning.AI media kit URL and a SocialBlade page) without any tool-based verification or data grounding. This is a hallucination (FM-4.1). Subsequent WebSurfer findings contradicted the claim (LinkedIn showing ~2M and X showing ~1.3M), but the team relied on the Assistant’s baseless figures, leading to the wrong conclusion that Twitter/X has the most followers.
